author: John Khan
about: Editable price table for the cost-per-edit meter. Every price is ASSUMED: none comes from an invoice, a price list or a contract. Change a value (or set it to null, which shows NOT_SET) and rerun make instrument-panel.

youcam_unit.note: No YouCam price per unit is on file; youcam/units.py holds unit counts only and the hackathon units are promotional (licences.json services). Replace with the paid plan's price per unit.

server_cpu_hour.note: One CPU hour on our API host, for edits the API renders itself. The free hosting tier bills nothing but is not cleared for a commercial launch (licences.json services). Replace with the chosen plan's price divided by its CPU hours.
